description: Resolve a human-readable name to addresses across ENS (Ethereum) and SNS (Solana). For .eth: returns Ethereum address via ethers. For .sol: returns Solana owner wallet via Bonfida SNS plus the wallet's other owned .sol domains. Names without a suffix are tried against both registries. Paid: $0.0005 USDC.

name.description: Name to resolve (e.g. "vitalik.eth", "bonfida.sol", or bare "vitalik" which is tried in both).

name: ens_sns_resolve
title: ENS + SNS resolve ($0.0005)
